repairs.why: Stored ep 103 record ends at 248 (p.1-12) with no continue point, implying resume at 249; but ch 248 p.13 opens ep 105, so the honest mid-chapter resume after ep 103 is 248. Omission fix consistent with the batch-14 convention used elsewhere (e.g. ep 125 continue->294).

flags_for_sean: ep 104 encoding: anchor is a position-carry record for a 100% anime-original episode (end 248, start_chapter null, chapters_adapted empty, continue 248). If the apply script rejects null start / empty chapters_adapted, the intended semantics are 'adapts nothing; reader position identical to post-ep-103 (mid-248)' — apply however filler-with-position is represented, but do not let the reorder regime interpolate across it.

ep 35 END=64 is a convention call inside a genuine page interleave: the episode also shows 66 (p.3-10) and 67 (p.2-5) as the head of the Midnight fight that ep 36 completes. If the position instrument should instead be the numerically furthest substantial chapter, END would be 66 (continue still differs). Chapter set itself is 2-source solid; marked medium for this reason only.

Page-level splits in the 46-50 and 60-67 zones are single-lineage (myheroacademia.fandom episode pages, cross-checked against the same wiki's chapter-side reverse maps, which agree page-for-page); AFG corroborates chapter sets only and episode/chapter title matches (chs 46, 49, 60, 63, 67, 157) corroborate the boundaries. This matches the evidence standard of the batch-14 records for 100-138.
